node.title: Rate-half MCA direction-support affine-basis payment
node.statement: After a minimum-lift codeword gauge with direction support e<=R and transformed explanation affine rank at most r, every active incident-normal basis must meet that support. Removing outside-only bases from the affine-span incidence numerator gives |Z|<=floor(P(R,r,e)M(K,r)), where P=1-(R+r-e)_fall_(r+1)/(R+r)_fall_(r+1) and M is the existing two-endpoint affine-span envelope. This pays uniformly over all shortened dimensions through e=15903,435,13 at KoalaBear ranks 12,13,14 and e=62235,1486,41,1 at Mersenne ranks 5,6,7,8.
